darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shopify order ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Shopify reference stored on the OMS order. In keepFieldsBase.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order total
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: In keepFieldsBase. Comparison only — not key-like.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order date
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: In keepFieldsBase. Epoch millis.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: In keepFieldsBase.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Store
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: NOT in keepFieldsBase; selected in the GraphQL document only when a filter or rule reads it.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Sales channel
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: NOT in keepFieldsBase; selected only when a filter or rule reads it. On the Order type since the 2026-10-28 moqui-gql upgrade; Steve Madden's daily order run excludes POS_SALES_CHANNEL on it.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Item quantity
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-251: the order's units, its item rows' quantities summed (HotWax keeps one row per unit), read from the items by order id only when a rule reads it. Compared against Shopify itemQuantity (Item Sync: itemQuantity = itemQuantity); orderItemCount is a copy of Shopify's line count, not this.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Has payment
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Y when the order carries at least one OrderPaymentPreference, else N. Compared against Shopify hasPaymentTransaction by the presence OPP rule (hasPaymentTransaction requires hasPaymentPreference, DAR-BE-126).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Completed
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-125: Y when statusId is ORDER_COMPLETED, else N. Compared against Shopify isFulfilled (isFulfilled required by isCompleted, DAR-BE-126).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment methods
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Comma-joined OPP paymentMethodTypeIds from the first two OPPs (detail, not a key).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment IDs
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined OPP manualRefNums (the Shopify transaction id each OPP names), read from up to five OPPs; null when all five slots came back full, so a longer list is never claimed short. Compared against Shopify paymentTransactionIds (paymentTransactionIds all in paymentRefNums).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: HotWax return ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: OMS return identity. Not offered as the ID (DAR-BE-071): HotWax-only, so it never joins to Shopify.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shopify return ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The Shopify return reference: the SHOPIFY_RTN_ID identification where present, else SHOPIFY_RETURN_ID. Not the join key: once a return is refunded Shopify SHOPIFY_RETURN_REFS reports the refund id, not this, so keying on it misses refunded returns. Fills externalId while a return has no refund yet.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shopify refund ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The join key. The Shopify refund id, matching Shopify SHOPIFY_RETURN_REFS's refundOrReturnId. BLANK on returns with no refund yet; the extract then fills it from shopifyReturnId, the return id Shopify reports until a refund exists.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shopify order ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Order spine — the Shopify order id of the return's order, resolved through OMS orders. Absent on a return with no items. Not offered as the ID (DAR-BE-071): one order can carry several returns, and duplicate keys collapse.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Return status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The RETURN's status. Includes RETURN_REQUESTED; RETURN_CANCELLED is excluded by the extract.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Created
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Epoch milliseconds. The extract windows on it.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Return total
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Sum of returnPrice x returnQuantity over the return's items.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Currency
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Server-side projected.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Return channel
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Return channel. Exclusion rules on it run client-side, after the built-in exclusions.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Store
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-068: the product store of the return's ORIGIN order (Return.productStoreId is unpopulated). NOT in keepFieldsBase: filters run before projection, so the pill filters without being compared. Absent on a return with no items, so an include rule drops those.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Returned by
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-094 R8: who the return is from (DISCONTINUED on gorjana's discontinued-stock returns). GraphQL only. NOT in keepFieldsBase: filters run before projection, so the pill filters without being compared.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite order ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-116 R8: the origin order's NETSUITE_ORDER_ID in HotWax, blank when that order never reached NetSuite. GraphQL only. NOT in keepFieldsBase: filters and conclusions read it, the compare does not.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Days before entry
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-116 R8: whole days between the return's own date (returnDate) and when OMS recorded it (entryDate); large for an old return recorded late. GraphQL only. NOT in keepFieldsBase.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: HotWax credit
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-192: the credit HotWax gave the return, each payment its responses refund counted once (0 when none). Only on a side with the withReturnCredit option. A rule that reads it keeps it through projection.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Shopify order GID.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order name
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Shopify order name.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Fulfillment status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: FULFILLED, UNFULFILLED, PARTIALLY_FULFILLED, RESTOCKED, ...

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: PAID, PENDING, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, REFUNDED, ...

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Sales channel
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: web, pos, shopify_draft_order, or an app id.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Needs shipping
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: false on orders with nothing to ship (gorjana's digital gift cards, POS carry-outs).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Cancelled on
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Set on a cancelled order.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Has payment
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-064: Y when any SUCCESS SALE, CAPTURE or AUTHORIZATION transaction exists, else N.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Fulfilled
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-125: Y when displayFulfillmentStatus is FULFILLED, else N (partial is N).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Payment IDs
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined ids of the SUCCESS SALE and CAPTURE transactions, and of a SUCCESS AUTHORIZATION nothing captured; the ids HotWax keeps on its OPPs as manualRefNum.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: All transaction IDs
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined ids of every SUCCESS transaction on the order, any kind (authorization, capture, sale, void, refund). Each HotWax OPP manualRefNum must be among them (paymentRefNums all in transactionIds); extra Shopify ids are fine.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Item quantity
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-251: units ordered (Order.subtotalLineItemsQuantity, the sum of line quantities as ordered, before refunds or removals). Compared against HotWax itemQuantity (Item Sync: itemQuantity = itemQuantity).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Refund/return ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RENAMED 2026-08-18 (was '$.records[*].eventId', labelled 'Event ID' then 'Refund or Return ID'): 'event' is this extractor's internal abstraction, not a Shopify term, and it surfaced verbatim on the rules board, the run summary and the diff columns. bareId-normalized identity — a REFUND id when refundOrReturnType is REFUND, a RETURN id when it is RETURN. Matches OMS externalId whichever kind it is: the single join key for returns reconciliation, with no precedence rule needed on either side.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Record type
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RENAMED 2026-08-18 (was '$.records[*].eventType'). REFUND or RETURN — identifies which kind of id refundOrReturnId carries on this row. Not a join key; useful for filtering or as a comparison field.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Order ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: bareId(legacyResourceId ?: id) — the bare GID tail, matching the numeric Shopify reference the OMS side stores. Unchanged by the per-refund/per-return reshape; still a grouping / secondary key, not the join key.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Created
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RELABELLED (was 'Order created', then 'Event created'): the individual refund's or return's own creation date — a refund row carries the refund's createdAt, a return row carries the return's — never the order's creation date. Windowing filters on this field, not on any order-level date.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Return status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: ADDED 2026-09-01 (DAR-BE-026), replacing the withdrawn returnWorkflowStatus pill — see the retirement entry in SourceSystemConnectorFieldWriteSupport.RETIRED_FIELDS. This is the endpoint's ONLY return-status field. Holds Shopify's own Order.returnStatus, an OrderReturnStatus: IN_PROGRESS, INSPECTION_COMPLETE, NO_RETURN, RETURN_FAILED, RETURN_REQUESTED, RETURNED. Those are the values to type, and they are the ones Shopify itself shows: the admin renders IN_PROGRESS as 'Return in progress' and the order search spells it return_status:in_progress. The withdrawn field held a per-return ReturnStatus instead, whose in-progress value is spelled OPEN — a word on no surface an operator could see — so excluding IN_PROGRESS matched nothing and reported a zero count, which reads exactly like an undeployed feature. Present on EVERY row, refund and return alike, because it describes the whole ORDER: excluding IN_PROGRESS therefore drops an in-progress order's refund rows as well as its return, which is deliberate — the per-return field it replaced could never reach a refund row at all. Key always present, null when Shopify reports nothing, so a consumer can tell 'extract predates the field' from 'Shopify said nothing'. Exclude IN_PROGRESS to drop orders whose return has not finished yet.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Match key
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The compare key: the product's NETSUITE_PRODUCT_ID (the NetSuite item internal id); HOTWAX-ONLY:productId when it has none, DUPLICATE:id:productId for every product after the first sharing one.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite item ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The NETSUITE_PRODUCT_ID identification, blank when the product has none.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: HotWax product ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: HotWax's own product id.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: SKU
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The product's internal name (its SKU).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Product type
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: FINISHED_GOOD or MARKETING_PKG_PICK.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Created
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: When HotWax created the product.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shared NetSuite ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: true when another sellable product carries the same NetSuite id.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite ID state
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: OWN: keyed on its NetSuite id; NONE: it has none (nsKey HOTWAX-ONLY:productId); SHARED: another product holds the id first (nsKey DUPLICATE:id:productId).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shared with
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The other sellable HotWax products carrying the same NetSuite id, comma-separated.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Sellable
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Y for a sellable product; N for a discontinued, virtual or non-selling product kept only because it carries a NetSuite id no sellable product holds.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Unsellable reason
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: discontinued, virtual, or the product type (DIGITAL_GOOD, SERVICE ...) when sellable is N.
